title: Moots Launches the County Line — an All-Road Bike Fit for SBT
content:
The new offering from the Steamboat Springs-based brand brings an all-rounder with 42mm of clearance to its titanium range of drop-bar bikes.

Read the full article at Moots Launches the County Line — an All-Road Bike Fit for SBT on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
